name: dod-closeout
goal: Close every §9 v1 DoD gap with a linked proof: guard-blocks-transcript pytest (incl. the hit() outside-repo escape found during Qoder verification), uv tool install smoke, and the §3/README fresh-machine command block run verbatim on a clean clone
accept: new guard transcript test: harness guard stdin event for a secret read exits 2 with an audit.log line, and an in-scope read passes untouched
install smoke: clean-venv uv tool install . then harness --help and harness scan on a scratch repo succeed; scripted as a test or scripts/smoke.sh
fresh-machine checklist: every README command block line runs verbatim from a clean clone in /tmp; gaps fixed in docs or code, or a no-changes-needed note in TECHNICAL_PLAN 3
full sweep green: python3 -m pytest -q, ruff check ., mypy .; scan --fail-under 70 still passes; changes stay in harness/, tests/, scripts/, README.md, TECHNICAL_PLAN.md

playwright.cmd: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test e2e/dashboard.spec.ts
